main_text.p: partē.Superlat.ὅτι τάδε μὲν, ἐπ' ἐκεῖνα ὁ. uel sic, ἐπὶ θάτερα μὲν, ὅτι θάτερα ὁ, pro citra et ultra dicūt. Et ἑκάσοι. pro ἑκάσος, unusquisque.
Similiter superlatiua, ἀλυπότατα, lœtissime. ἀοχνότατα, impigerrime. ἀνεκτότατα, ignauissime, κεχαριςμένως, gratissime.Cōparat. Comparatiua uero non item; nā semper per singulare enunciantur.
main_text.head: Appendix. Enallage partium.
main_text.p: Præterea neutra adiectiua tam singularia quàm pluralia, frequentissime aduerbiorum uice habentur, ἡδὺ uel ἡδέα (ἁρπὺ αἰάσων Pind.) γελᾶ, blande ridet.Enallage partium. Item masculina & fœminina nonnunquam, ἀγχίθυρος γαῖσα πλησίον, Theoc.Theocr. Idyll. 2. nonnunquam binæ dictiones, σὺν ἀγαθῇ τύχῃ, pro εὐτυχῶς, σὺν δαίμονι pro εὐδαιμόνως, &c. Pari modo aduerbia quandoque loco sunt nominum, οἱ πλησίον μὲν, οἱ πλήσιοι μὲν.
main_text.head: Appendix secunda. Enallage qualitatis.
main_text.p: Nomina adiectiua neutri generis accipiuntur nonnunquam abstractorum loco, et more illorum admittunt genitiuum.Enallage qualitatis τὸ σοφὸν τῆς ἀρέτου, pro ἡ σοφία τῆς ἀρέτου.

page.notes: Marginal notes in left margin: Superlat., Cōparat., Enallage partium, Theocr., Enallage qualitatis. Greek text is partly damaged and some accents are uncertain; the Greek of the last lines is approximate.
